project_type: Vite + React 19 SPA, Supabase backend (auth + postgres), Tailwind CSS dark-theme dashboard
build_system: Vite 8 — `npm run build` compiles; `npm run dev` starts dev server on localhost:5173. No test runner.
test_framework: None. Verification is: `npm run build` must exit 0 with no errors.
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` from c:\PRIVATE\gaming-dashboard. Build must complete with exit code 0 and no JSX/import errors. Also run `npm run lint` to catch any unused-import or prop warnings.
snapshot_or_generated_files: supabase-schema.sql is the migration file — manually applied in Supabase SQL Editor. It is NOT auto-run; it is committed to the repo so the admin can copy-paste it. All SQL additions must go to the bottom of this file as an explicit migration block.
environment_constraints: Do NOT restart the dev server. Do NOT push to git. All SQL belongs in supabase-schema.sql as a migration block at the bottom — never in a separate file.
contribution_requirements: Match existing code style exactly: named exports, async/await with try/catch, supabase client from src/lib/supabase.js, dark-theme glass-card pattern, lucide-react icons. No TypeScript, no new libraries.
key_patterns: db.js: named async exports, throw error on failure. AuthContext: register(fullName, email, mobile, password) returns {success, error}. Pages: useAuth() for profile/refreshProfile. glass-card CSS class for cards. inputClass variable for form inputs. Sidebar userNav array for nav items. App.jsx has explicit route list.
directory_structure: src/pages/user/ — user-facing pages; src/pages/admin/ — admin pages; src/lib/db.js — all DB helpers; src/context/AuthContext.jsx — auth state; src/components/Layout/ — Sidebar, Layout wrapper; supabase-schema.sql — DB schema + migrations at project root
